updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.6.9 
- Summary since last Beta commit:
  - ATC FLOW / Suppress Auto rework: manual-gated ATC and carrier progression now blocks auto sequencing until matching pilot calls are made, while preserving expected follow-up responses.
  - Added managed ATC.lua orig+append install path tied to Suppress Auto, including clean restore behavior on unload.
  - Refined runway and carrier voice/progression gating for Request Landing, Check Landing Gear, Taxi to Parking, Tower Overhead, and Ball flows.
  - AH-64D George AI updates from Sleighzy integrated (command/control and contextual mapping reliability improvements).
- OpenKneeboard Out: added Navigraph EFB integration WIP.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: added chart rotation and fit controls.
- OpenKneeboard Out: enhanced kneeboard EFB and FLT PLN UI behavior, presentation and controls.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: added stylus-only radial chart search overlay with center token display and Back/Clear actions.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: added previous and next hover icons for quick chart browsing.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: annimated search overlay motion to slide out from and retract back into the left rail/drawer flow.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB tab: moved SA Map from FLT PLN into the EFB viewing area with preserved Navlog route rendering.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: integrated moving-map controls using EFB follow ownship, track-up, anchor, center-ownship, and layer toggles.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: added optional fast-ownship source toggle (GPS icon) for troubleshooting and legacy fallback switching.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: improved ownship rendering stability during refresh and layer changes to prevent heading/follow reset and icon strobing. 
- Fix minor regression with bugging of Map overlay assets in Track up and follow selected 
- Fix bug in DTC and RTE loading
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB: added live module/session gate for charts and SA map with explicit no-module messaging when bypass is off.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: fixed fallback overlap so only one ownship symbol renders when OpenFreeMap is active.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: enlarged and re-anchored magenta ownship marker so triangle tip is the true position point.
- OpenKneeboard Out simulation mode: fixed ownship route-motion startup logic and source selection; ownship now advances reliably along route.
- OpenKneeboard Out simulation mode: added simulated tanker/AWACS metadata (frequency/TACAN) for bugged asset info popups.
- OpenKneeboard Out simulation mode: corrected track-up ownship heading orientation and heading-source precedence.
- OpenKneeboard Out UI: normalized EFB/FLT PLN empty-message font sizing to match standard tab message text.
- AIRIO RIO: reclassified and renamed LANTIRN Stabilize command to LANTIRN category/key consistency (wMsgLANTIRN_STAB_GROUND).
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map JTAC: added active-target overlay with target marker, friendlies cue, egress cue, and reciprocal attack-sector rendering.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map JTAC: added layered attack-sector range bands for run-in planning (1-5nm, 5-10nm, 10-15nm).
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map JTAC: improved nine-line popup persistence for active and history TGT markers, including remarks retention across JTAC log progression.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map JTAC: added target history behavior with black TGT-1..TGT-10 markers and active-to-history handoff on new nine-line assignment.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB SA Map: improved JTAC overlay stability so current markup holds through non-nine-line JTAC chatter until a new burst target is assigned.
- OpenKneeboard Out EFB Charts: updated Saved Games path handling to use localization-aware root discovery for non-English and redirected profile setups.
- AH-64D George AI: refactored George command/control handling and contextual behavior mapping for improved reliability and maintainability. 
- AH-64D George AT Pilot: Added George AI pilot commands and recipient,
